summary: Join our training course on water scarcity and climate change. Discover the risks involved and explore innovative solutions to combat this global challenge.
lede: Water scarcity and climate change planning helps organizations understand how changing climate conditions affect water availability and reliability. Designed for water, sanitation, climate, public-sector, NGO, utility and corporate professionals, the course supports practical decisions about reducing water risk and strengthening resilience. Participants learn to assess risks, interpret climate information, compare solution options, and develop prioritized plans with financing, monitoring and communication approaches.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly plan, invest, or make decisions affected by water availability and climate risk.
audience: Public sector staff in water, environment, agriculture
Utility managers and technical teams (water supply
Corporate sustainability, ESG, and HSE professionals
Agriculture and irrigation managers, agribusiness planners
modules: Water Scarcity in a Changing Climate: What It Means for Your Work
Drivers of Water Scarcity and Demand Pressure
Water Risk Assessment for Organizations and Programs
Climate Information for Planning and Decision Making
Water Efficiency and Demand Management Solutions
WASH, Public Health, and Equity Under Water Stress
Financing Water Resilience and Solution Prioritization
Communicating Water Risk and Defending Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of water management concepts and basic familiarity with climate adaptation strategies. Prior experience in project management or environmental planning is beneficial.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
